primary_task: Build a sales battlecard for a named competitor using the 5-layer intelligence framework.

requirements.name: public web research (web_search, or web_fetch of competitor sites, G2/Capterra, Crunchbase, LinkedIn, TechCrunch)
requirements.evidence: | **Product moves** | Changelog, G2/Capterra reviews, Twitter/LinkedIn | Monthly | ... | **Funding** | Crunchbase, TechCrunch, LinkedIn | Triggered |
requirements.basis: tools.web_search: "search the public web and read result snippets" (web_fetch of these hosts is refused: tools.web_fetch "hosts outside the egress allow-list are refused")

requirements.name: internal intel (sales call intel, win/loss interviews, customer feedback)
requirements.evidence: | **Pricing changes** | Pricing page, sales call intel, customer feedback | Triggered | ... | **Customer losses** | Win/loss interviews, churned accounts | Ongoing |
requirements.basis: tools.ask_user: "ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation"

requirements.name: templates/battlecard-template.md
requirements.evidence: **For Sales (CRO):** Battlecards — one page per competitor, designed for pre-call prep. See `templates/battlecard-template.md`
requirements.basis: tools.skill: "load an installed Claude Code skill"; the manifest does not say whether the bundled template ships with the skill.

requirements.name: CRM / Notion / Confluence / Salesforce (distribution)
requirements.evidence: | AEs + SDRs | Updated battlecards in CRM | Monthly + triggered | CRO | ... All competitive intel lives in one place (Notion, Confluence, Salesforce).
requirements.basis: tools.notion: "Notion connector (the user's workspace): ... notion-create-pages" (CRM, Confluence and Salesforce are not listed; forbid_effects: "writes_external", "publishes")

notes: Research is one requirement satisfied by any web source; web_search snippets are available while direct fetches of G2, Crunchbase, LinkedIn etc. are outside the allow-list. If a reader insists on fetching full pages (e.g. pricing page, Crunchbase profile), that path is unavailable and the deliverable would rely on search snippets and user-supplied intel. Distribution to CRM/Notion is follow-up work, not part of the battlecard, and would hit the writes_external/publishes forbid.
